queries.sql: SELECT o.country, ROUND(SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.country ORDER BY o.country

SELECT o.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS revenue_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.country ORDER BY o.country

WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1_2025' WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q4_2024' END AS qtr, SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date) SELECT qtr, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, ROUND(AVG(net_order_value),2) AS avg_order_value_net FROM order_net WHERE qtr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

WITH order_gross AS (SELECT o.order_id, CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1_2025' WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q4_2024' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date) SELECT qtr, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, ROUND(AVG(order_value),2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_gross WHERE qtr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr
SELECT * FROM customer_segments ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 10

WITH line_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, (oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS net_val, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.country = 'France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'), seg AS (SELECT ln.*, cs.segment FROM line_net ln LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id = ln.customer_id AND ln.order_date >= cs.valid_from AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR ln.order_date < cs.valid_to)) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN net_val ELSE 0 END),2) AS vip_net_revenue, ROUND(SUM(net_val),2) AS total_net_revenue, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN net_val ELSE 0 END)/SUM(net_val),2) AS vip_share_pct FROM seg

WITH line_gross AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS gross_val, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.country = 'France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'), seg AS (SELECT lg.*, cs.segment FROM line_gross lg LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id = lg.customer_id AND lg.order_date >= cs.valid_from AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR lg.order_date < cs.valid_to)) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN gross_val ELSE 0 END),2) AS vip_gross_revenue, ROUND(SUM(gross_val),2) AS total_gross_revenue, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN gross_val ELSE 0 END)/SUM(gross_val),2) AS vip_share_pct FROM seg

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_items, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS distinct_items FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_items_seg FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date>=cs.valid_from AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date<cs.valid_to) WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) AS total_returned FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
